en.title: Minimum Total Distance Matching Servers to Centers One-to-One
en.description:
There are n servers and n data centers on a line. Each is used exactly once to form a pair, and the cost of a pair is the absolute difference of their coordinates; minimize the total cost. The one-to-one semantics are established by the source's pairing example: a server cannot be used more than once.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line the server coordinates, and the third line the center coordinates. 1≤n≤100000, coordinates 1..10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: 1 pairs with 2 and 10 with 9, total 2. Example 2: all points coincide, cost 0. Example 3: the only possible pairing, distance 999999999.
hints: Sort both coordinate lists, pair them in the same order and sum the absolute differences.
